blind.description: A stylized medieval crossbow lying flat on the ground. It features a carved brown wooden stock with a shaped butt, dark grey metallic bow limbs curved at the front, a taut light-brown bowstring running across the flight groove, and a metal foot stirrup loop attached to the front end. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and clean with stylized hand-painted textures, fully intact with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it has a distinct cross/T-shape oriented horizontally, showing the long wooden stock extending to the left and right, intersected by the curved metallic bow limbs and a straight string, with a hexagonal metal stirrup loop at the right tip.
blind.height_vs_figure: Lying flat on the ground, its height is only a few inches (less than 1/10th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure); its overall length is roughly 2.5 to 3 feet and its bow width is about 1.5 to 2 feet.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
